title: Consent Group
summary: Consent checkboxes that are never pre-ticked and keep required terms apart from optional purposes, and record what was agreed and when.
description: Boxes are never pre-ticked, required terms sit apart from optional purposes, Accept all spells out what it will tick first, one sentence reads back the choice, and each change produces a record with time, method, text version and a fingerprint of the wording.
catches: Optional purposes bundled with required terms
"Accept all" ticking more than the person read, by listing it first
Changes to consent wording, via a version and a fingerprint in each record
limits: The fingerprint is a short FNV-1a hash for spotting wording changes, not a tamper-proof signature
Records are passed to you; storing them and honouring withdrawal is up to your backend
Not legal advice: whether consent is valid depends on your jurisdiction and context
a11y: Required and optional sections are role="group" with headings via aria-labelledby
Each checkbox has a <label> and aria-describedby to its description
Accept-all confirmation is a labelled group; focus moves to Confirm and Escape cancels
The required marker is aria-hidden; requirement is stated in the heading
server: Store consent records server-side with the exact text version shown, and let users withdraw as easily as they gave consent.

rules.note: Not verified against the primary source on 2026-10-17: EUR-Lex could not be fetched. Recital 32 text ("Silence, pre-ticked boxes or inactivity should not therefore constitute consent") was read on a secondary reproduction only. Informational, not legal advice.
